channel.title: BEIM GOODS Blog
channel.description: Livestream chat market trends, audience engagement tips, and step-by-step guides for adding text-to-speech to streaming and meeting platforms.

item.title: How Do I Improve Livestream Audience Engagement? The Modality Effect
item.description: Livestreamer (Twitch, Kick), live commerce sellers (Whatnot, eBay, Poshmark), or live meeting presenters (Zoom, Google Meet) can utilize scientific process to foster a more audience engaging experience. Chat TTS is a powerful tool for livestreamers who need to respond to chat while their eyes are on the game, the product, or the slides.

item.title: How to Boost Sales on Whatnot
item.description: Whatnot Show sellers and hosts can boost sales by adopting chat TTS to enable active listening and fast replies to boost sales. Responding within 5 minutes increases conversion rates dramatically.

item.title: Is Your Text-to-Speech Sending Data to the Cloud? How to Check in 30 Seconds
item.description: Your TTS voice might be sending your chat content to a third-party server for processing? Here's how to check in 30 seconds, and what to do about it.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to Whatnot Live Show
item.description: 90% of live sellers work alone without a Mod to monitor chats. Missing buyer questions like "what size?" or "bundle shipping?" means missing sales. A lightweight TTS reads those questions aloud so sellers never miss a sales opportunity.

item.title: Paid vs. Free — The Fine Print on Livestream Chat TTS
item.description: There is no such thing as free software. Free software has hidden price tags (e.g. your privacy). A clear $1/month price means you're the customer, not the product.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to Google Meet
item.description: During a Google Meet presentation in fullscreen mode, the presenter can't see audience comments. This blog shows presenters how to add a lightweight TTS without the extra CPU overhead and not leaving the slides.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to Zoom Meetings
item.description: Zoom presenters in fullscreen mode can't see chat, and reading chat stresses human visual receptors and is distracting (per Modality Effect). A 70KB browser extension reads Zoom chat aloud during presentations without the performance hit.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to YouTube Live
item.description: YouTube Live Streamers can engage better with audience by adding a lightweight TTS. This is a how-to blog. The Chat TTS works for both YouTube Live and YouTube Studio.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to Twitch
item.description: Two of the biggest pain points for Twitch streamers: CPU overhead from extra software and not being able to read chat while gaming fullscreen. This is a how-to blog to add Chat TTS, no OBS required, runs locally, minimal CPU usage.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to Kick
item.description: Kick streamers experience dropped frames, which disappoints viewer. This is a how-to blog on adding a 70KB TTS extension reads Kick chat aloud without taxing CPU or bandwidth. There is no OBS required.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to StreamYard
item.description: StreamYard lets streamers multistream to Facebook, Instagram, Twitch, Kick, LinkedIn and more. Here's how to add a lightweight TTS to StreamYard to hear chat across all those destinations.

item.title: How to Add TTS Text-to-Speech to eBay Live
item.description: 90% of eBay Live sellers work alone with no assistant. A TTS extension reads buyer questions aloud so sellers never miss a sale.
